AboutPage.title: Two decades building the UAE's chilled water networks.
AboutPage.subtitle: Since 2003, Island Tower Electromechanical Works LLC has grown from chilled water flushing specialists into a full district cooling and MEP contractor, for clients who need it done right the first time.
AboutPage.storyHeadline: Built on a specialty most contractors didn't have.
AboutPage.storyP1: Island Tower was established in 2003 as one of the first companies to establish the chilled water flushing industry in the UAE, taking on a landmark project at Palm Jumeirah the following year. That specialization built the reputation for precision our clients still rely on today.
AboutPage.storyP2: We've since grown into a group of companies spanning infrastructure, civil engineering, MEP, water, chemical, and energy work across the UAE and Saudi Arabia — approved by the RTA and Dubai Municipality, with around 90% of our projects still coming through referrals rather than a sales team.
AboutPage.milestone1Text: Island Tower Electromechanical Works LLC is established in Dubai, specializing in chilled water flushing — one of the first companies to do so in the UAE.
AboutPage.milestone2Text: Awarded our first landmark project: chilled water flushing for Palm Jumeirah.
AboutPage.milestone3Text: Delivered our first international chilled water flushing project, in Kuwait.
AboutPage.milestone4Text: Appointed main contractor for the district cooling network at Jumeirah Village Triangle.
AboutPage.milestone5Text: Appointed main contractor for the district cooling network at Jumeirah Village Circle.
AboutPage.milestone6Text: Appointed main contractor for the district cooling network at Dubai Academic City.
AboutPage.capability1Desc: As a full-service mechanical and electrical engineering firm, we coordinate specialists across every discipline instead of treating each trade in isolation — one team, one accountable delivery.
AboutPage.capability2Desc: From design and fabrication to installation, commissioning, and ongoing repair and maintenance, we deliver plumbing, mechanical, electrical, and flushing contracts as a single turnkey scope.
AboutPage.capability3Desc: Qualified managers, engineers, foremen, and skilled technicians give us the technical depth to handle contracts of any magnitude across every electromechanical discipline.
AboutPage.capability4Desc: A reputation for quality workmanship, flexibility, and on-time delivery is why so many of our clients, consultants, and contractors keep coming back to us project after project.
AboutPage.heroLine: Since 2003, chilled water networks and MEP works across the UAE and Saudi Arabia.
AboutPage.galleryHint: Scroll or drag to walk round
AboutPage.chairmanQuote: As the Managing Director of Island Tower Group of Companies, I am immensely proud of what we have achieved over the years. Our journey from a small chilled water contractor to a leader in construction across various sectors reflects our commitment to excellence and innovation. The expansion of our operations globally signifies our growing influence and dedication to shaping sustainable environments. I am profoundly grateful to our talented team, whose relentless drive and ingenuity have propelled us to new heights. Together, we continue to build on our accomplishments, driven by a shared vision of excellence and sustainability.
AboutPage.chairmanBio: Sasikumar Vasukurup Madhaviamma is the Managing Director of Island Tower Group of Companies. Its electromechanical company, Island Tower Electromechanical Works LLC, has grown from a specialized chilled water flushing contractor into a trusted electromechanical partner across the UAE and Saudi Arabia since 2003.
AboutPage.visionText: To be the most innovative and respected electromechanical engineering partner in the region, redefining standards through sustainable practice and pioneering technology.
AboutPage.missionText: To pioneer electromechanical solutions that elevate communities and promote sustainability across every project we deliver.
AboutPage.value1Desc: We conduct our business with the highest ethical standards, ensuring transparency and fairness in all our dealings.
AboutPage.value2Desc: We strive for superior performance and quality in every aspect of our business, pushing boundaries to achieve the best outcomes.
AboutPage.value3Desc: We champion new ideas and approaches, continuously seeking out new technologies and methods to improve our work and impact.
AboutPage.value4Desc: We are committed to environmental stewardship, implementing eco-friendly practices that contribute to sustainable development.
AboutPage.value5Desc: We believe in the power of teamwork, both within our company and with our partners, fostering a collaborative environment that enhances productivity and results.
AboutPage.value6Desc: Prioritizing the health and safety of our employees and all stakeholders is fundamental to our operations.
AboutPage.qualityDesc: Our operations are certified under ISO 9001:2015. Our quality management system runs on continuous improvement — planning, doing, checking, and acting (PDCA) applied from ground-level site activity up to strategic decisions, with resources and performance tracked against real-time site data at every stage.
AboutPage.hseDesc: We believe every incident is preventable. Every team member is empowered with the authority to halt operations the moment safety standards aren't met, backed by leadership held to the same accountability standard.
AboutPage.sustainabilityDesc: A reuse, reduce, recycle framework runs through how we plan every project — evaluating decommissioned materials for reuse, ordering just-in-time to cut waste, and recycling GRP and plastic waste through dedicated on-site sorting.
AboutPage.technologyDesc: BIM-driven coordination, drone site surveys, 3D scanning, and RFID-tagged asset tracking across our equipment fleet keep projects measurable and on schedule, not just estimated.
AboutPage.approvalsHeadline: Approved to work where the networks run.
AboutPage.rtaDesc: Approved to carry out district cooling works within Dubai's right of way.
AboutPage.iso45001Desc: Occupational health and safety management system.
AboutPage.buildText: From the trench to the plant room, our companies cover the work a cooling network depends on, so one team carries it through.

ServicesPage.title: District cooling first. Full MEP behind it.
ServicesPage.subtitle: Everything a chilled water network needs, from the right of way to the energy transfer station, and the building services that connect to it.
ServicesPage.s1Desc: Pioneers of the chilled water flushing industry in the UAE, we design, install, and commission district cooling piping networks and chilled water systems — including temporary cooling plants for interim capacity during construction or upgrades. Our own flushing fleet runs pumps up to 1,600 m³/hr and HDPE welding equipment up to 450mm diameter, verified by ultrasonic flow testing on pipes up to 1,400mm.
ServicesPage.s2Desc: MV and LV switchgear installation, MDB and SMDB distribution board fit-out, and MV cable laying — engineered for straightforward maintenance and built with room for future expansion.
ServicesPage.s3Desc: Full HVAC design and installation, plumbing and drainage systems, and firefighting and fire suppression systems, executed to one quality standard across residential, commercial, and industrial buildings.
ServicesPage.s4Desc: KNX-based building automation for centralized control of HVAC, lighting, and security, paired with real-time energy monitoring systems that give clients visibility into consumption as it happens.
ServicesPage.s5Desc: Industrial process piping and compressed air piping for manufacturing and processing facilities, installed to the precision these environments demand.
ServicesPage.s6Desc: Retrofit works that upgrade existing MEP infrastructure for efficiency without disrupting ongoing operations, plus modular installation methods that cut construction time and labor cost on new builds.
ServicesPage.s7Desc: LV panel installation, testing and commissioning, and MV cable laying for site-wide electrical infrastructure — the groundwork every other system depends on.
ServicesPage.dcDescription: One contractor for every stage of the network: installation, flushing, connection, testing and commissioning.
ServicesPage.dc2Desc: Flushing and chemical cleaning of new and existing chilled water networks and systems, using our own high-volume pump fleet, to bring water quality to specification before handover.
ServicesPage.dc3Desc: Energy transfer station installation and upgrades, valve replacement, and hot tapping to add new branches to live networks without shutting them down.
ServicesPage.dc4Desc: Excavation, valve chambers, trench shoring and reinstatement for district cooling networks within Dubai's right of way, approved by the RTA.
ServicesPage.dc5Desc: Plant-side chilled water piping, pumps and equipment installation, including temporary cooling plants for interim capacity.
ServicesPage.dc6Desc: Pressure testing, weld inspection and ultrasonic flow verification, through to commissioning and handover.
ServicesPage.mepDescription: Design, installation, commissioning and maintenance contracts for the mechanical, electrical and plumbing systems inside the buildings.
ServicesPage.equipDescription: Flushing and testing run on Island Tower equipment, not hired-in kit.
